reason: A DeepSeek Harness agent preset that orchestrates model-specific bootstrap and promotion phases, controls tool and context exposure, and maintains stability across long sessions.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按模型路由的智能体预设，通过分阶段工具开放、上下文门控和 epoch 会话管理来稳定长会话行为。
summaries.en: An agent preset for DeepSeek Harness that uses model-aware routing, staged tool exposure, context gating, and epoch-based session management to stabilize long sessions.

capabilities: Configures DeepSeek Harness agent behavior and model-specific routing
Controls staged tool exposure and context injection during sessions
Maintains epoch-aware session state across compaction, resume, and restart
Provides custom Bash path handling for Windows environments
